indicator_definition: Number of persons held in prison per 100,000 inhabitants. Reflects criminal justice practices. Data compiled by Eurostat from national penitentiary statistics.
rationale: Monitoring prison populations provides insight into criminal justice and rule of law. Imprisonment should be proportionate and consistent with fair justice principles.
methodology_characteristics: Data compiled from national penitentiary administration statistics. Refers to total persons held on a reference date. Published annually by Eurostat.
